name: Parameterized SM80 MMA.SYNC method
summary: Use the SM80 MMA.SYNC family for A == fp16 && B == fp16 && C == fp16 && D == fp16, selecting a supported instruction shape and layout from CUTLASS wrappers.

strategy.intent: Map GEMM arithmetic to architecture-native Tensor Core instructions.
strategy.mechanism: Distribute register fragments across 32 threads and issue the exact MMA.SYNC PTX instruction exposed by the CUTLASS wrapper.
strategy.expected_benefit: Uses the GPU matrix-multiply datapath instead of scalar arithmetic.
tradeoffs: Requires compatible fragment layouts, data types, alignment, and architecture support.

The normalized method aggregates the concrete instruction shapes listed in parameters.

references.evidence: The CUTLASS wrapper emits this exact SM80 MMA.SYNC instruction.
